about: Hand-written English negatives (SPR-33 GC8). Each case applies the listed replacements to a copy of fixtures/en/<root> and expects exactly these rule keys and this exit code; an empty rule list is a variant that must stay clean.

cases.name: heading-renamed
cases.why: The required Risks heading is renamed, so it is missing.

cases.name: heading-renamed-tiny
cases.why: A combined sprint needs its Result part under that name.

cases.name: summary-heading-renamed
cases.why: The plain-language summary heading is the full label, not a shorter word.

cases.name: level-not-on-the-scale
cases.why: A level cell must be Blocker, Must fix, Should fix or Note.

cases.name: level-from-the-old-scale
cases.why: An old-scale word stays flagged in an English document.

cases.name: note-uppercase-without-locale
cases.why: GC2: NOTE is a level only when the document declares locale en; with no locale key it is the old scale.

cases.name: note-uppercase-under-locale-en
cases.why: GC2 counterpart: the same cell is clean when the document declares locale en.

cases.name: conclusion-label-missing
cases.why: The conclusion block needs the Conclusion label.

cases.name: goal-field-missing
replaces: - **Sprint goal:** export the order list to CSV with every column.
cases.why: The PLAN goal block needs the Sprint goal field.

cases.name: labels-of-another-locale
cases.why: A Vietnamese heading in a document that declares en is read, but noted.

cases.name: declared-locale-differs
cases.why: A sprint folder whose documents declare different locales; the English labels also disagree with the declared vi.

cases.name: declared-locale-unknown
cases.why: A locale that is not shipped is invalid.
